items.title: BioNTech Tumbles 8% as Colorectal Cancer Vaccine Trial Fails, Moderna Drops 6%, Pfizer Holds Flat
items.summary: BioNTech's colorectal cancer vaccine just collapsed in a Phase 2 trial, dragging Moderna down with it despite last week's melanoma triumph, and the fallout is forcing investors to rethink how far mRNA technology can actually reach into solid tumors.
